Module com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval
Package com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model

Class GameModel

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_batalla_naval.model.GameModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameModel extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the complete state of a Battleship match. This class stores the human player, the computer-controlled player, and the current turn. It acts as the central model of the game and provides utility methods to determine whether the match has ended.
